host.title: Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote SSH server.

private_key.title: Private Key
private_key.description: PEM-encoded private key used for SSH authentication.

remote_path.title: Remote Path
remote_path.description: Absolute path on the remote server to use as the content root (e.g. /data/documents).

allowed_extensions.title: Allowed File Extensions
allowed_extensions.description: Restrict ingestion to files whose name ends with one of these extensions.
